Class Line

java.lang.Object
shapes.MyShape
shapes.Line
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Cloneable
public class Line extends MyShape
Line is a concrete subclass of MyShape representing a line defined by two endpoints. It provides methods to draw the line, move it, and access its properties.

This class is part of a JavaFX-based shape editor application.

Example usage:


 Point2D start = new Point2D(10, 20);
 Point2D end = new Point2D(50, 60);
 Line line = new Line(start, end);
 line.setColor(Color.BLUE);
 line.draw(graphicsContext);
